character_facts: The Zacuda Frolex is depicted as an insect-like lifeform.
The original Zacuda Frolex dies after laying one egg.
The offspring is a mutant Zacuda Frolex created after the egg absorbs shocks from the machine.
continuity_links: This page appears to narrate the origin of the mutant Zacuda Frolex introduced as a later threat or significant creature.
The transformation is directly linked to the interaction between the egg and the computer machinery at Police Central.
dialogue_meaning: The narration frames Police Central as an ugly metallic urban structure.
A Zacuda Frolex dies in a computer keyboard or key mechanism.
Its egg remains inside the machine long enough to be affected by the environment there.
Artificial rain and elapsed time set up the transformation.
Electrical or mechanical shocks from the machine cause the egg to hatch into a much larger mutant version of the species.
locations: a minor computer identified by the number sequence BT-45891020354662
lore_facts: Police Central exists as a major metallic structure in this setting.
Artificial rain occurs in this environment.
There are 'minor' computers with individually identified machine designations.
A Zacuda Frolex can lay an egg at the moment of death.
Machine shocks can alter the development of a Zacuda Frolex egg, resulting in mutation.
The mutant offspring is described as enormous relative to the original insect.
plot_events: Police Central is introduced visually as a massive metallic structure.
A dying Zacuda Frolex falls between the keys of a minor computer inside or associated with Police Central.
Before dying, the creature lays a single egg.
Time passes during a period of artificial rain.
The city is shown under a red evening sky after the rain.
The egg, altered by shocks from the machine, hatches.
An enormous mutant Zacuda Frolex is born from the machine.
visual_summary: A sequence of narrated panels shows the metallic bulk of Police Central, then explains that a Zacuda Frolex dies there and drops between the keys of a numbered minor computer. The insect lays a single egg before dying. After a period of artificial rain and a red sunset over the city, the egg hatches inside the machine, producing a large mutant Zacuda Frolex amid machinery and fluid.
